metadata.question: Did nighttime lights in Obolon, Ukraine, decrease in May 2022 compared to March 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use NOAA VIIRS Nighttime Lights (ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21")) which provides monthly composites - Compare May 2022 (2022-05-01 to 2022-05-31) vs March 2022 (2022-03-01 to 2022-03-31) - Location: Obolon district, Kyiv, Ukraine (approximately 50.5°N, 30.55°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Nighttime lights data doesn't require cloud masking in the traditional sense (it's already processed monthly composite) - Use the 'avg_rad' band which represents average radiance - No water/cloud masking needed for this analysis 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check if collections have images (size > 0) - Check pixel count after reducing region (count > 0 means valid pixels) - Compare mean radiance values: if both are valid numbers, compare them - A result of None/NaN would indicate C3 - Invalid geometry or no data would be C1/C2 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Obolon, Ukraine geometry (district center, ~15km radius) const obolon = ee.Geometry.Point([30.55, 50.5]).buffer(15000); // 2. Load VIIRS Nighttime Lights Monthly data const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V21') .filterBounds(obolon); // 3. Filter for March 2022 const march2022 = viirs .filterDate('2022-03-01', '2022-03-31') .select('avg_rad'); // 4. Filter for May 2022 const may2022 = viirs .filterDate('2022-05-01', '2022-05-31') .select('avg_rad'); const marchSize = march2022.size().getInfo(); const maySize = may2022.size().getInfo(); print(`March 2022 Images: ${marchSize}`); print(`May 2022 Images: ${maySize}`); // 5. Check for empty collections if (marchSize === 0 || maySize === 0) { print("Missing data for one or both months."); print("C1"); return; } // 6. Calculate mean radiance for March 2022 const marchImg = march2022.first(); const marchStats = marchImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const marchMean = marchStats.getInfo()['avg_rad_mean']; const marchCount = marchStats.getInfo()['avg_rad_count']; // 7. Calculate mean radiance for May 2022 const mayImg = may2022.first(); const mayStats = mayImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: obolon, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mayMean = mayStats.getInfo()['avg_rad_mean']; const mayCount = mayStats.getInfo()['avg_rad_count']; print(`March 2022: Mean=${marchMean?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${marchCount}`); print(`May 2022: Mean=${mayMean?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels=${mayCount}`); // 8. Validate results if (marchCount === 0 || mayCount === 0) { print("No valid pixels in one or both months."); print("C2"); return; } if (marchMean === null || mayMean === null || isNaN(marchMean) || isNaN(mayMean)) { print("Calculation resulted in invalid values."); print("C3"); return; } // 9. Compare values const decreased = mayMean < marchMean; const difference = marchMean - mayMean; const percentChange = ((mayMean - marchMean) / marchMean * 100).toFixed(2); print(`Change: ${difference.toFixed(3)} (${percentChange}%)`); if (decreased) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, () => { ee.initialize(null, null, () => { runAnalysis().then(resolve).catch(reject); }, reject); }, reject); }); } initEE(); ```
